applies_to: Institutional training grants (T32, T90, TL1) and individual fellowships (F32). Senior fellows (F33) are capped at the 7+ year level.
effective: Awards made on or after October 1, 2025 (supersedes NOT-OD-25-105)
how_levels_work: The stipend level for the entire first year of support is determined by the number of full years of relevant postdoctoral experience when the award is issued. The stipend for each additional year of NRSA support is the next level in the structure and does not change mid-year.
note: This is the NIH NRSA stipend scale, not a market pay rate. Many institutions set postdoc salaries above these floors.
program: Ruth L. Kirschstein National Research Service Award (NRSA)
verified_against: NIH Guide Notice NOT-OD-26-044, postdoctoral stipend table (grants.nih.gov)
